amc_universe: 3,800 Ehrl/geobr 1970-2010 minimum comparable areas; identical to POLOCENTRO treatment assignment

construction.grid: Balanced AMC by union-of-outcome-years grid; missing source outcomes remain null and are never interpolated.
construction.logs: Natural logs of strictly positive levels.
construction.growth: 100 times within-AMC log change divided by elapsed years between consecutive observed source years.
construction.state: 2010 constituent-municipality UF; AMC 11052 uses ES by municipality plurality and retains ES|MG plus a cross-state flag.
construction.controls: Predetermined 1970 census/GDP variables and static 1961-1990 GAEZ suitability repeated over the outcome year grid.

added.log_population_1970: Baseline scale and exposure for count outcomes.
added.log_gdp_per_capita_1970: Baseline development/productivity not captured by income-bin composition alone.
added.va_agriculture_share_of_gdp_1970: Predetermined productive specialization, central to treatment selection and agricultural outcomes.
added.literacy_share_age15plus_1970: Human capital; the operational-core treated-control standardized difference is about 0.54 before adjustment.

control_selection_assessment.econometric_note: All controls are time-invariant. AMC fixed effects absorb their levels; use them for weighting/matching, interactions with time, state-by-year fixed effects, or heterogeneous effects rather than adding their raw levels to a unit-FE regression.

important_cautions: MapBiomas starts in 1985, ten years after January 1975 assignment, so land-cover outcomes cannot identify pre-treatment trends.
Population and interstate migration have only the 1970 pre-treatment census observation; they cannot support conventional multi-lead pre-trend tests without another source or design.
The 1980 interstate-migration measure uses recent residence plus birth-UF as a proxy; other years use the definitions documented in the AMC metadata.
Native-vegetation loss is net stock loss, not gross deforestation; within-AMC recovery can offset clearing.
The 1970 income-quintile shares are conditional on positive income among residents age 15+.

year.definition: Outcome year; controls are repeated over the outcome key grid.

log_gdp_total_2010_brl_thousand.definition: Log AMC GDP in constant 2010 R$ thousand; strictly positive values only.

log_va_agriculture_2010_brl_thousand.definition: Log AMC agriculture value added in constant 2010 R$ thousand; strictly positive values only.

gdp_total_annualized_log_growth_pct.definition: 100 times the log GDP change divided by years since the prior observed GDP year.

va_agriculture_annualized_log_growth_pct.definition: 100 times the log agriculture-VA change divided by years since the prior observed GDP year.

pasture_share_of_mapped.definition: MapBiomas pasture hectares divided by mapped AMC territory.

agriculture_share_of_mapped.definition: MapBiomas agriculture hectares divided by mapped AMC territory.

soybean_share_of_mapped.definition: MapBiomas soybean hectares divided by mapped AMC territory.

native_vegetation_net_loss_share_of_1985.definition: Signed cumulative native-vegetation stock loss since 1985 divided by 1985 native-vegetation hectares; recovery can offset loss.

weighted_interstate_migrants.definition: Survey-weighted interstate in-migrant stock in the age-5+ migration universe.

interstate_migrant_share_of_destination_.definition: Interstate in-migrants divided by destination AMC residents age 5+.

log_population.definition: Log survey-weighted usual-resident population; strictly positive values only.

population_annualized_log_growth_pct.definition: 100 times the log population change divided by years since the prior census.

positive_income_q1_share_age15plus_1970.definition: 1970 share of age-15+ positive-income residents in the national lowest positive-income quintile.

positive_income_q3_share_age15plus_1970.definition: 1970 share of age-15+ positive-income residents in the national third positive-income quintile.

female_share_1970.definition: Female share of the AMC population in 1970.

urban_share_1970.definition: Urban share of the AMC population in 1970.

share_age_65plus_1970.definition: Share of the AMC population age 65 or older in 1970.

log_population_1970.definition: Predetermined 1970 log population; added scale control.

log_gdp_total_1970.definition: Predetermined 1970 log total GDP in constant 2010 R$ thousand; added baseline-outcome/scale control.

log_gdp_per_capita_1970.definition: Predetermined 1970 log GDP per resident in constant 2010 R$; added development control.

va_agriculture_share_of_gdp_1970.definition: 1970 agriculture value added divided by GDP; added productive-structure control.

literacy_share_age15plus_1970.definition: 1970 literacy share among residents age 15+; added human-capital control.
